notes.title: Roles Reversed - A totally normal update
notes.content:
🤩Pop of the morning to you!🤩

I'm happy to share a new update with you, that is totally not an April Fools update.
In this new gamemode, called 🧻Roles Reversed🧻, you play as...the box!

Instead of deciding where the emoji drops in the box, you now decide where the box is when you drop the emoji.
But! Be careful! Don't let any emojis fall out of the box, or you'll lose.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799867/dc5e633fbd54dac88771074822791f61db69a007.gif

I hope you enjoy the new gamemode!

Also, I've added some new achievements.

Enjoy!

TheShelfman
-------------

Changes:

 Added new gamemode, "Roles Reversed". Play as the box!
 In Mountain Climber gamemode; changed "Highscore" to "Lowscore" because it seems funnier
 Added several new achievements

notes.title: New content? In this economy?
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I added a new game mode to Popmoji: Mountain Climber.
In this gamemode, you try to lose with as little points as possible! But the funny part is that it's pretty windy, so the emojis are constantly moving in one direction. So good luck trying to lose as quickly as possible.

New gamemodes and abilities will be coming in the future. Let me know if there's anything you'd like to see in particular!

notes.title: The Game Modes Update!
notes.content:
🤩Pop of the morning to you!🤩

It's finally here! The Game Modes update!
I'm happy to share that besides the original Popmoji game mode with all the special abilities, there are now 10 more game modes to explore. Some with large changes, other with small changes.

Some of my favorites:


-Moon Bouncer-
More bounce and less gravity
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799867/782780db9f1cce72502f4b7536c9da270da914e7.jpg


-Out Of Control-
Emojis slowly grow in size with time
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799867/482aa3883c2d32d383aeba658f131fd8ab1eaf26.png


-Keepie Uppie-
Completely different! Keep the emojis up in the sky for as long as possible
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799867/370fde4406537ba5a275be304be0fa50f7155d4f.jpg


And 7 more! With all of those new game modes, I've also gone ahead and added a bunch new achievements, 25 to be exact. So happy achievement hunting!

I've also added 2 new abilities to add to the collection:

Thor's Hammer : Remove one of every kind of emoji present in the box
Shuffle : Switch every emoji with another emoji; position and scale!

I'm super excited to see what scores you all will reach with these new game modes. I'm hoping to see you all reach crazy highscores.

That said, I am not quite sure what the future will hold for Popmoji, but if you have any ideas, feel free to let me know! This might not yet be the end for Popmoji.

Thank you, and enjoy!

TheShelfman

notes.title: Rerolls & Colors Update!
notes.content:
🤩Pop of the morning to you!🤩

Finally a new update, while I'm working on a big update in the meantime.

There's a new ability, the cloud abiliy. It will cover your screen for about 30 seconds, but in the meantime, anytime you get points, you get 10x the regular score!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799867/b5b2bb52fbd247b0dfd30c97d45dd0159d534b14.png

Besides that, two new buttons have been added to the ability screen. Bomb button and reroll button. They cost a certain percentage of your points, but can be incredibly useful when going for that highscore!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799867/007b85faaf050377c580bf8df5df0438e259bd3e.png

And finally, you can now give all emojis a distinguishable color! Some people found the yellow to make it difficult to see which emoji was which, especially when they're flat. That's fixed now.

I'm still working on the gamemodes for the big update (or well...I've only just started on it)
In the meantime, enjoy!

TheShelfman

notes.title: The Stats & Turtles Update
notes.content:
🤩Pop of the morning to you!🤩

It’s been a couple of days since Popmoji launched, and I’m honestly blown away by how much you all seem to be enjoying it. So before anything else, thank you so much for playing the game, and making the battle for the #1 spot on the leaderboard so much fun!

Now, for the new update…
Welcome everyone to the Stats & Turtles update!

The main addition to the game in this update is the stats page! You can now see several stats from your time playing the game, like the amount of rounds you’ve played, how many emojis you’ve merged, how many breads you’ve breaded, etc. There’ll probably be more added, but these are already a couple of fun ones!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799867/d6f86fce2488a0356cf9ec26f54940e6f926a5a6.gif

I, for one, know now that I tested the game nearly 100 times from the moment I added the basics of this feature till releasing the update…🙃
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799867/7d5243b06d90b1b536afa4aada38db9fd89242c0.gif

*Note: Since this feature is brand new, it will start from 0 for everything. It will not know how many games you’ve played before this. Sorry about that!


But what about the turtles?? Let’s get to that.
Player, and current first place on the leaderboards, JustLikeMarkie, came with a great idea to give turtles different looks. And now they do.
This isn’t anything you can do anything about. Just whenever you activate the turtle ability, it’ll show a random turtle visual. Enjoy, they’re quite fun!
I personally really like the one with the glasses.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799867/fc77c8cc21ac1b8c4efd69e340bdd392082e3d3a.gif


No new abilities in this update, but there’ll be several in the next big one, I promise!
There are however a bunch new achievements, and more to come as well.

Until then, keep popping, and leave a review while you’re at it😁
You can find the full changelog below.

Enjoy,

TheShelfman
